newsitem.title: USA: General Bearing inks $54 mln GM contract.
newsitem.headline: General Bearing inks $54 mln GM contract.

text.p: General Bearing Corp said Thursday it has reached a three-year, $54 million agreement to supply wheel and axle bearings to General Motors Corp.
The company said it expects to ship about $12 million against the order in 1998 and $18 million annually thereafter for the life of the contract.
General Bearing said it is in discussions with the other major U.S. car companies. The company manufactures, sources, assembles and distributes a variety of bearing components and bearing products.
